why: Inverts resolveBulletHits' outbound exemption, so a tank is immune to its own returning ricochet and vulnerable to the shell it is currently firing. Load-bearing since issue #237: the spawn circle now overlaps the firer's own hull, and this guard is the only thing stopping a tank killing itself on the trigger pull.
killedBy: resolveBulletHits does not self-destruct in the muzzle but can self-hit on a ricochet return
spawnBullet: the muzzle plane vs the shell centre (issue #237) does not let a tank shoot itself on the way out with a ricochet shell, born inside its own hull
